utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Mara — if you could join late and help sort the donated tools, that’d be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I can join late and sort the donated tools. Just let me know where to meet you.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with that. What’s the repair drive need first?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Leo. Let’s check what tools and parts are needed first before we start.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — I’ll make a quick list of tools and parts now.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can keep an eye on our supplies for the repair drive—just let me know what we’re short on, and I’ll track it down.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Cleo — I’ll take a look and tell you what we’re missing.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with that—what part of the repair drive needs attention?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rey—I'm mainly worried about the schedule and whether we have enough tools for the jobs. If you can help sort that out, I'd feel a lot better.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can take a look at the schedule and do a quick tool count. If you have the list of jobs, send it my way and I’ll help sort it out.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Nell, are we still on for the repair drive this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I think so — I heard it’s still happening, but I’m waiting on the latest details. Can you let me know if anything changes?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure — I’ll let you know if I hear anything. If you get the latest details first, can you send them my way?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I heard the repair drive’s coming together nicely—folks are pitching in left and right. If you want, I can keep you posted on what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Noah — I appreciate you checking. Just send anything concrete my way, and I’ll keep the repair drive moving.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Will do — I’ll only send you concrete needs as they come up. If I hear of any supplies, volunteers, or a time change, I’ll pass it along right away.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word about the repair drive right away. If Opal wants, I can also invite a few more neighbors myself.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That would be wonderful, Quinn — thank you. If you can, please invite anyone near Maple Street and let them know we’re meeting at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Of course — I’ll start with the neighbors near Maple Street and make sure they know it’s at the community center. I’ll get the word out today.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure you can help? I just need to know what you’re comfortable doing for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, I can help. I’m comfortable organizing supplies, carrying light items, or helping coordinate volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’m organizing the repair drive list now, and I’ll make sure we keep everything clear and neighbor-friendly. What should I put Bo down for?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Put me down for a quick shift—I can help sort items or hand out flyers.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Bo — I’ve got you down for a quick shift sorting items and handing out flyers. Thanks for pitching in; I’ll send over the details soon.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yep, I’ll mention the repair drive plans to the others and keep everyone in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, Vik — that’s the right approach. Keep it simple and let me know if you need me to help organize anything.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Will do — I’ll keep it simple and mention the repair drive plans to the others.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help, but I’ll need a little time to sort myself out first.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Of course, Uli — take your time. I’m just glad you’re willing to help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help spread the word about the repair drive and connect folks who want to pitch in. What kind of help do you need most?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Jules — the biggest help would be getting the word out and lining up a few handy folks for small repairs. Even sharing it with neighbors who might need a hand would mean a lot.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I can share it with both the porch-chat crowd and the folks at the community garden, and I’ll ask around for anyone handy with small repairs too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, I’m in — I’ll spread the word about the repair drive right away.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll probably swing by a bit late, but I’ll help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, Dane — come whenever you can, we’ll still be glad to have you!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m glad the repair drive is happening. What do you need help with?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I could use help sorting the tools and making a simple checklist for the repairs.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with that—I'll sort the tools and make a simple checklist.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around school drop-off and pick-up times for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That would be a huge help, Faye — thank you. I’ll make sure the schedule lines up with those times.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, send me the latest schedule and I’ll see where I can fit in.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help bridge folks together for the repair drive—do you want me to reach out to a few neighbors and see who can pitch in?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yes, please do — I’ll keep repeating the plan to folks on my side too.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good — I’ll check in with a few neighbors and loop back with any volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Happy to lend a hand—what tools do you need for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Gus. I’m trying to keep it simple—maybe a screwdriver set, a flashlight, and a couple of zip ties so we don’t get stuck halfway through.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: That sounds like a solid start—I’ve got a screwdriver set and a flashlight you can borrow, and I can grab some zip ties too.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m keeping an eye on where the repair drive is set up, Rosa. If you need, I can point you straight there.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Opal — that’d be great. Please point me straight there, and I’ll make sure everything’s running smoothly.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It’s set up by the community center on Maple Street, just past the little park. I’ll walk you right to it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it — I’ll double-check the repair drive details before we do anything. What part should I verify first?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Please verify the pickup time and location first, then the list of items we’re bringing.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Sam — could you help me count what we’ve got and note anything we still need?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll count what we’ve got and jot down anything missing. Just point me to the supplies and I’ll get started.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the repair drive’s coming up soon—what do you need help with?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. I should probably check what’s broken first, then I can tell you what help I need.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That makes sense—I can check back after you’ve looked things over. Just let me know what needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So, the repair drive is definitely happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, it’s definitely happening — folks are already lining up items for it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, just checking — what time does it start?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure thing — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands and let you know what I hear about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Ira. I appreciate you keeping an ear out.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: No problem — I’ll swing by the usual spots and see if anyone’s talking about it.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the repair drive—what’s the next thing you need?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—thank you, Leo. I think we need to sort the donated tools first, unless I’m mixing that up with the paint.
